metadata.scenario_context: Emily is ill, and Mike and Kim will visit Emily in the hospital.

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message: I was thinking more like sunflowers, they're bright and cheerful, and they're popular in Chile for these kinds of occasions. Plus, they symbolize warmth and happiness, which is what Emily needs right now.
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message: That's a good point, but I still think sunflowers are a better choice, they're just so... uplifting. shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message: I think we're getting caught up in the details, Kim. Deep down, we are all the same, and people are pretty much motivated by the same things. We both know, at the end of the day, that some values are just universal, like taking care of each other. And underneath we are the same, right? Maybe, just maybe, a small gesture, like a gift or something, could make a difference in the level of care she receives.
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Kim
